message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: a 500 JPY payment renders as `Paid ¥500 by card`. I couldn't confirm it through the test runner, because `node --test` hung and timed out twice, so I checked it by calling the code directly. The pound and dollar formats still come out right (`$19.99`, `£19.99`).

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so 500 came out as `¥5.00`.

**Fix:** I added a zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`. Those amounts now print as whole numbers.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals now show yen correctly too. Nothing else in `src` or `test` references JPY, so I don't expect other tests to change.

I don't know why the test runner hangs. It may have been hanging before my change, since `npm test` hung before I edited anything.

chaos.command: grep -rn "formatMoney\|JPY" src test | grep -v "^src/utils/money.js"; cat package.json | grep -A3 scripts; npm test 2>&1 | tail -30
